install.//: Expo SDK 57 pins jest ~29 for jest-expo. This project tests the agent core headless with ts-jest and never uses jest-expo (see AGENTS.md), so jest 30 is deliberate — ts-jest 29.4 declares support for jest ^29 || ^30.

scripts.//run: `ios`/`android` start the dev server for fast JS iteration. `expo prebuild` rewrites these to `expo run:*`, which makes every run a full native compile — if that happens again, change them back and use the :build scripts instead.
scripts.//build: Native compiles. Needed only after changing app.json, native config, or adding a native module — and to verify anything Expo Go's own Info.plist masks (e.g. userInterfaceStyle).
